title: CGC Gate 1.0 Edge Cloud Autonomy Summary
subtitle: Edge-cloud autonomy capability closure and governance summary for UI/dashboard consumption

headline.summary: Gate 1.0 has a real autonomy substrate, and Host1 plus Host2 now both pass all eight audited capability buckets.

status_breakdown.label: Target

status_breakdown.label: Stub
status_breakdown.description: Declarative or adapter-only capability without credible runtime closure.

formally_claimable: Zero-Copy or low-copy device resume is materially present in the current codebase.
Cloud tp4ep4 prefill backbone is materially present and now validated through real DeepEP builder output on host1 and host2.
task_type contract and bundle governance chain are materially present and auditable.
CQ4 transport, TrueOrthoKDA compression, DOPD handoff, DeepSeek-V4-Flash resume/decode, and OMLX plus FlashMoE autonomy all pass the current Host1/Host2 verifier chain.

validation_snapshot.summary: Current Host1 and Host2 verifier runs close all eight audited Gate 1.0 capability buckets as done.
